556:t_1:86.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That is what a $$ウィスパード$$ is.」

556:t_1:87.en:
$$隼人$$
「...There's one thing I don't understand. Who is it that's sending that Black Technology?」

556:t_1:88.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The one who sends information to the $$ウィスパード$$... In other words, the source of the $$ウィスパリング$$ is...」

556:t_1:89.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$カナメ$$ from the future.」

556:t_1:91.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To be precise, it is most likely the doing of the personality of $$ソフィア$$... a girl who fell victim to the experiment 18 years ago and is now possessing $$カナメ$$.」

556:t_1:92.en:
$$タケル$$
「So the will of a human whose body perished 18 years ago is controlling her now...」

556:t_1:93.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And it is believed that, through the will sent by the $$ウィスパリング$$, the world walked a path entirely different from the history it was originally meant to follow.」

556:t_1:94.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The culmination of that is the existence of the AS.」

556:t_1:96.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「True enough... The way that weapon came into being could even be called abnormal.」

556:t_1:97.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The technology used in the AS doesn't fit into any existing system. It is, so to speak, something like a mutation.」

556:t_1:98.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「In other words, they're a product of Black Technology.」

556:t_1:99.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Those technologies gave rise to further derivatives, and it can be said they influenced the very state of the world.」

556:t_1:100.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ called that a warped world.」

556:t_1:101.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Together with those who agree with him, such as $$カリーニン$$, $$レナード$$ is trying to cause a new $$時空震動|lc$$ in order to set this world right.」

556:t_1:102.en:
$$桂$$
「Put simply, it's a selfish $$時空修復|lc$$, huh.」

556:t_1:103.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「To think that Major $$カリーニン$$ had defected to $$アマルガム$$...」

556:t_1:104.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Everyone has their own reasons. Forget about him.」

556:t_1:105.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To that end, $$レナード$$ developed the $$時空震動弾$$ and, on top of that, built the system to control it, 《$$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$》.」

556:t_1:106.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We found out that it was being built on $$メリダ島$$ and tried to destroy it, but...」

556:t_1:107.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$レナード$$ had it transferred to the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$.」

556:t_1:108.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The underground there still hasn't been checked. So they moved the system there...」

556:t_1:109.en:
$$マリ$$
「But, you know, I've been thinking. Even if those guys say they're going to do a $$時空修復|lc$$, couldn't we just leave them alone?」

556:t_1:110.en:
$$マリ$$
「It'd just create one new parallel world, so it's not like it would affect our world or anything.」

556:t_1:111.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I have no intention of denying that way of thinking.」

556:t_1:112.en:
$$テッサ$$
「However, $$レナード$$ has taken many lives to carry out that plan.」

556:t_1:113.en:
$$宗介$$
「At the very least, he took $$千鳥$$'s freedom and twisted her fate.」

556:t_1:114.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That act is unforgivable, and if a $$時空震動|lc$$ on a scale that remakes the world were to occur, I couldn't guarantee its effects on spacetime, either.」

556:t_1:115.en:
$$アスカ$$
「One wrong move and the world's done for. Just like $$サードインパクト$$.」

556:t_1:117.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That is why I intend to stop his ambition, for the sake of the people who became victims of his plan as well.」

556:t_1:118.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If you want to call that a personal grudge, feel free. But I have no intention of changing my mind.」

556:t_1:119.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You don't have to shoulder the responsibility and sense of mission alone, $$テッサ$$.」

556:t_1:120.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Faced with a crisis of the world being destroyed, we have no intention of standing by and watching, either.」

556:t_1:121.en:
$$ランド$$
「I've got a score to settle with that bastard for what he did to us in $$第２新東京市$$, too.」

556:t_1:122.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We cannot allow a $$時空修復|lc$$ driven by ego.」

556:t_1:124.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're okay with it too, right, $$マリ$$?」

556:t_1:125.en:
$$マリ$$
「I never said I was against it, you know.」

556:t_1:126.en:
$$マリ$$
「Besides, I personally don't like people who think it's OK for them alone to do whatever they want.」

556:t_1:127.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The situation appears to be one where every moment counts. We will head for the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$ in one hour, when sortie preparations are complete.」

556:t_1:128.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Everyone, board your units and stand by. Take it to heart that this battle will decide the fate of the world.」

556:t_1:130.en:
$$万丈$$
「...To think the world's ruin was gaping open this close, right before the future of despair.」

556:t_1:131.en:
$$桂$$
「But if the future of despair, or the great collapse of the universe that comes once every 120 million years, counts as a spacetime disaster, then this operation carries great meaning.」

556:t_1:132.en:
$$勝平$$
「What do you mean, Big Bro $$桂$$?」

556:t_1:133.en:
$$桂$$
「When I touched the $$集合無意識$$ on $$神根島$$, I learned that $$オルソン$$ and I are powerless against the spacetime disasters likely to come.」

556:t_1:134.en:
$$オルソン$$
「We are $$特異点$$s of the $$大時空震動$$, but at present, it seems that we alone don't have the power to return spacetime to its original form... its most stable state.」

556:t_1:135.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「'Our power alone'... So that's the key.」

556:t_1:136.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Exactly. When I was held in a $$サイデリアル$$ research facility, one of the researchers there said this about $$特異点$$s.」

556:t_1:138.en:
$$万丈$$
「So that means there's one more besides you and $$桂$$... another $$特異点$$ who is a key to $$時空修復|lc$$?」

556:t_1:139.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The one who was there at the beginning of the current, confused spacetime... The $$始原の特異点$$, huh...」

556:t_1:140.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Do you know about it, $$グーラ$$?」

556:t_1:141.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The place or space where the $$時空震動|lc$$ began... the so-called $$大特異点$$. Gather the $$特異点$$s' will there, and the $$時空修復|lc$$ is completed...」

556:t_1:142.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I have the knowledge, at least.」

556:t_1:143.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Then if $$桂$$ and the others go to that $$大特異点$$, will this whole multiverse go back to the way it was?」

556:t_1:144.en:
$$グーラ$$
「In theory. But I have no idea where the knot of all these parallel worlds, tangled up this complexly, is located.」

556:t_1:145.en:
$$オルソン$$
「For the sake of the universe-scale crises to come as well, it will probably be necessary for us to gather all three $$特異点$$s.」

556:t_1:146.en:
$$桂$$
「So that's why I figure the third one is $$かなめ$$.」

556:t_1:147.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see... If she's a being with enough power to warp the world, the possibility is definitely there.」

556:t_1:148.en:
$$桂$$
「Exactly. We absolutely can't lose this battle... for the sake of the future.」

556:t_1:149.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To think that $$かなめ$$ had that kind of power...」

556:t_1:150.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A hidden, mysterious power...! It has something in common with $$ノノ$$, too.」

556:t_1:151.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Honestly... This one doesn't seem to grasp how important this is, does she, $$ニコラ$$.」

556:t_1:154.en:
$$チコ$$
「What's wrong? Are you worried about something?」

556:t_1:156.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「If we could do something like that, we wouldn't be struggling.」

556:t_1:158.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'd rather you not say words like that so lightly.」

556:t_1:160.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「'Changing the world' is a phrase only someone who has truly tasted despair has the right to say.」

556:t_1:163.en:
$$タケル$$
「Calm down. What did $$シンジ$$ do?」

556:t_1:164.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$$タケル$$... You can't understand how I feel.」
